Prove unique output of normalized composition plus zero or one reduction from fullgcd/Bezout and bounded remainder equations.
Certify all five addition-by-(X,1) phases by explicit polynomial witnesses.
Define arithmetic step by its unique normalized output, then prove agreement with the candidate successor.
Injective positions conjugate the actual step to residue increment, proving return afterj iff n dividesj.
